facts.fact: The Interior Minister says illegal use of the NIN by third parties falls under Law 18-07 of 10 June 2018 on protection of individuals in personal data processing, with its stated sanctions.
The Interior Minister says infractions will be sanctioned in coordination with the Autorite Nationale de Protection des Donnees a Caractere Personnel.
